question: What state is attained by one freed from all diseases, in relation to union together with yogis?
premises: One becomes freed from all diseases.
That one is in relation to yogis.
Union together with yogis is attained.
inference: Freed from all diseases, one attains union together with yogis.
uncertainties: The nature of 'union together' is not defined in this verse.
plain_english: Freed from all diseases, one attains union together with yogis.
